zh-CN.name: 开放性
zh-CN.summary: 对新想法、艺术、情感体验和变化的接纳程度。
zh-CN.high: 好奇、富有想象力，喜欢新鲜事物和抽象的思考，乐于尝试不同的做法。
zh-CN.mid: 在新与旧之间比较平衡：愿意尝试新事物，也重视实用和熟悉的方式。
zh-CN.low: 务实、脚踏实地，偏好熟悉、具体、经过验证的方式，对抽象讨论兴趣不大。
zh-CN.getAlongHigh: 和 TA 聊新想法、新体验；给 TA 尝试不同做法的空间。
zh-CN.getAlongLow: 说明事情的实际用处，给出具体例子；不要频繁变动已经定好的安排。

en.name: Openness
en.summary: How open someone is to new ideas, art, emotional experience and change.
en.high: Curious and imaginative; enjoys new things and abstract thinking, and likes trying different approaches.
en.mid: Balanced between new and familiar: willing to try new things while valuing practical, proven ways.
en.low: Practical and down-to-earth; prefers familiar, concrete and proven ways and has little interest in abstract debate.
en.getAlongHigh: Talk about new ideas and experiences; leave room for trying things differently.
en.getAlongLow: Explain the practical use of things with concrete examples; avoid changing agreed plans often.

zh-CN.name: 尽责性
zh-CN.summary: 自我管理、计划性和坚持完成目标的程度。
zh-CN.high: 有条理、可靠、自律，习惯提前计划，做事有始有终。
zh-CN.mid: 在计划和灵活之间保持平衡，重要的事情会认真对待。
zh-CN.low: 随性灵活，不喜欢被计划束缚；有时可能拖延或丢三落四。
zh-CN.getAlongHigh: 守时守约，事先说清楚安排；TA 对质量的要求是认真，而不是挑剔。
zh-CN.getAlongLow: 把重要的事拆成小步骤、约好检查时间；多一些灵活和包容。

en.name: Conscientiousness
en.summary: How organised, self-disciplined and goal-directed someone is.
en.high: Organised, dependable and self-disciplined; plans ahead and follows through.
en.mid: Balances planning and flexibility; takes important things seriously.
en.low: Spontaneous and flexible, dislikes being tied to plans; may sometimes procrastinate or forget things.
en.getAlongHigh: Be on time and keep agreements; their standards come from care, not fussiness.
en.getAlongLow: Break important tasks into small steps with check-ins; allow some flexibility.

zh-CN.name: 外向性
zh-CN.summary: 从社交和外部活动中获得能量、表达热情的程度。
zh-CN.high: 热情、健谈、精力充沛，喜欢与人交往，常常主动带动气氛。
zh-CN.mid: 能享受社交，也需要独处的时间来恢复精力。
zh-CN.low: 安静、内敛，更喜欢小范围的交流或独处，在熟悉的环境中更自在。
zh-CN.getAlongHigh: 多一起活动、多交流；及时回应 TA 的热情。
zh-CN.getAlongLow: 提前告知安排，给 TA 思考和独处的时间；一对一交流比在人群中更好。

en.name: Extraversion
en.summary: How much someone draws energy from social contact and outside activity.
en.high: Warm, talkative and energetic; enjoys people and often livens things up.
en.mid: Enjoys company but also needs time alone to recharge.
en.low: Quiet and reserved; prefers small groups or solitude and is most at ease in familiar settings.
en.getAlongHigh: Do things together and keep talking; respond to their enthusiasm.
en.getAlongLow: Give notice of plans and time to think alone; one-to-one works better than crowds.

zh-CN.name: 宜人性
zh-CN.summary: 待人友善、合作、信任和体谅他人的程度。
zh-CN.high: 体贴、乐于助人、容易信任别人，重视人际和谐。
zh-CN.mid: 友善但有自己的立场，必要时会坚持己见。
zh-CN.low: 直接、注重事实和公平竞争，不轻易信任别人，必要时敢于提出反对。
zh-CN.getAlongHigh: 表达感谢；TA 不容易拒绝别人，要留意 TA 是否在勉强自己。
zh-CN.getAlongLow: 直接说重点、用事实讨论；TA 的反对多半针对事情而不是针对人。

en.name: Agreeableness
en.summary: How friendly, cooperative, trusting and considerate someone is.
en.high: Considerate, helpful and trusting; values harmony.
en.mid: Friendly but with their own views; will stand firm when needed.
en.low: Direct, focused on facts and fair competition; slow to trust and willing to disagree.
en.getAlongHigh: Show appreciation; they find it hard to say no, so check they are not overstretching.
en.getAlongLow: Get to the point and argue with facts; their objections are usually about the issue, not you.

zh-CN.name: 情绪敏感性
zh-CN.summary: 体验焦虑、烦躁、低落等负面情绪的倾向（心理学中称为“神经质”，这不是贬义，也不是疾病）。
zh-CN.high: 情绪反应较强，容易担心、紧张或感到压力；同时往往对风险和细微变化更敏感。
zh-CN.mid: 大多数时候情绪平稳，压力较大时会有明显波动。
zh-CN.low: 情绪平稳、不易焦虑，在压力下通常能保持冷静。
zh-CN.getAlongHigh: 多给予确定的信息和安慰，避免突然的变化；认真对待 TA 的担心。
zh-CN.getAlongLow: TA 看起来很平静，不代表不在意；重要的感受可以直接问。

en.name: Neuroticism
en.summary: The tendency to experience negative emotions such as worry, irritation or low mood (a research term — not an insult, not an illness).
en.high: Reacts strongly; worries, tenses up or feels stressed easily, and often notices risks and small changes.
en.mid: Mostly steady, with noticeable ups and downs under heavy stress.
en.low: Emotionally steady and rarely anxious; usually stays calm under pressure.
en.getAlongHigh: Offer clear information and reassurance, avoid sudden changes, and take their worries seriously.
en.getAlongLow: Looking calm does not mean not caring; ask directly about important feelings.
